         1                 P R O C E E D I N G S

         2                  ACTING PRESIDENT STEWART-COUSINS:

         3       The Senate will please come to order.

         4                  I ask everyone present to rise and

         5       repeat with me the Pledge of Allegiance to the

         6       Flag.

         7                  (Whereupon, the assemblage recited

         8       the Pledge of Allegiance to the Flag.)

         9                  ACTING PRESIDENT STEWART-COUSINS:

        10       In the absence of clergy, may we all bow our

        11       heads for a moment of silence.

        12                  (Whereupon, the assemblage

        13       respected a moment of silence.)

        14                  ACTING PRESIDENT STEWART-COUSINS:

        15       Thank you.

        16                  Senator Klein.

        17                  SENATOR KLEIN:    Madam President,

        18       is there a proclamation from the Governor at

        19       the desk?

        20                  ACTING PRESIDENT STEWART-COUSINS:

        21       Yes, Senator Klein, there is a proclamation

        22       here at the desk.

        23                  The Secretary will read.

        24                  THE SECRETARY:    "Pursuant to the



                      Candyco Transcription Service, Inc.

         1       power vested in me by Article IV, Section 3 of

         2       the Constitution, I hereby convene the Senate

         3       of the State of New York in Extraordinary

         4       Session at the Capitol, in the City of Albany,

         5       on the twenty-eighth day of June, two thousand

         6       nine, at six o'clock p.m., for the purpose of

         7       acting on gubernatorial nominations and

         8       considering legislation, and for the

         9       consideration of such other nominations or

        10       legislation as I may recommend.

        11                  "Given under the hand and the Privy

        12       Seal of the State in the City of Albany this

        13       twenty-seventh day of June in the year

        14       two thousand nine, by the Governor, David A.

        15       Paterson."

        16                  ACTING PRESIDENT STEWART-COUSINS:

        17       The proclamation having been read, the Senate

        18       is in extraordinary session.

        19                  Senator Klein.

        20                  SENATOR KLEIN:    Madam President,

        21       I move that we do not take up any legislative

        22       activity today and we adjourn this

        23       extraordinary session sine die.

        24                  ACTING PRESIDENT STEWART-COUSINS:
